items.title: What is tidegate
items.text:
tidegate is an open source privileged access management tool. It decides who may reach your production systems, for how long and with which permissions.

tidegate is in early development and not ready for use yet. To follow along or contribute, see the repository on GitHub.

items.title: Development environment
items.text:
The README lists the tools you need and how to get them with Nix.

Once you have them, run just in the repository to see the recipes. just ci runs every check that CI runs.

To work on this site, run just docs::serve and open the address it prints. The page reloads when you change a file in docs/content/.
